description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs lines 185-188: The DuplicateCertificate error variant doc says: "A certificate appearing at two positions in the chain (or two distinct certificates that share the same public key) indicates a likely error in chain construction." The second clause — "two distinct certificates that share the same public key ... indicates a likely error" — is incorrect for cross-certification topologies where two different CA certs intentionally carry the same key. The doc should either: (a) narrow the claim to only cover the same DER cert at two positions, or (b) note this as a known false-positive for cross-signed chains and reference the P0 issue above.
title: P4: check_inputs DuplicateCertificate doc says 'two distinct certs sharing same key indicates chain construction error' — this is false for cross-signed certs
